$comment: The single source of truth for every origin this project runs on. The portal lives on liha.dev; the demo apps live on their own domain, because they are deliberately ordinary sample apps and do not belong on the product domain. Adapter definitions, the extension manifest, the service worker's static-origin list and the portal's demo links all derive from this file. Kept as JSON so the extension build (plain Node) and the TypeScript sources can read the same bytes.
